war_summary: War 139 is on day 95 with no winner yet. Colonials hold a majority of strategic bases across the map, but Wardens control several key regions. The highest intensity fighting is concentrated in a few regions with very high casualty rates and frequent base ownership changes: CallahansPassageHex, ClahstraHex, EndlessShoreHex, OarbreakerHex, OnyxHex, and MooringCountyHex. These regions show accelerating casualty trends on both sides, high enlistment growth, and recent capture events indicating active frontlines. Most other regions are quiet with low casualties and no recent base changes. Uncertainty remains around whether the current high-tempo fights will produce decisive base flips or stabilize, and whether Warden-held regions like BasinSionnachHex or ClansheadValleyHex will come under pressure.
